P: Pariyāgāra，（adj．） [pari+āgāra] having the house all round，entirely surrounded by the house Vin．III，119 （of gabbha）．（Page 432）
R:
pariyāgāra：ပရိယာဂါရ （တိ） （ပရိ+အာဂါရ）
တန်ဆောင်းဝန်းအရံ ရှိသည်။
DOP: pariyāgāra m. [pari + agāra], an inner surrounding terrace or arcade; Vin III 119, 17 (tassāyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti … majjhe gabbho samantā ~o; Sp 532, 5 foll.: samantā pan’ assa maṇḍalamāḷaparikkhepo hoti, so kira majjhe caturassaṃ gabbhaṃ katvā bahi maṇḍalamāḷaparikkhepena kato yathā sakkā hoti anto yeva āviñjantehi vicarituṃ); Sp 1220, 3 (pakuṭṭan ti pi majjhe gabbhassa samantā ~o vuccati; Sp-ṭ [ Be ] III 396, 3 : samantato āviddhapamukhaṃ).
